criteria.criterion: A test in athena-core (run with `cargo test -p athena-core`) builds a rejected job with candidate, all checks passed, no unmet criterion, and one major finding whose location is docs/decisions.md:3005-3053; qualifies_for_tree_retry returns true for it.
criteria.evidence: docs_only_rejection() starts from content_only_rejection (checks passed, has a candidate), sets one met behavior criterion and one Major finding at docs/decisions.md:3005-3053, and asserts qualifies(). The test passed in my run. With the old rule (an unmet criterion was required) it would return false, so the test fails without the change.

criteria.criterion: Tests show retry still starts from the base (qualifies_for_tree_retry false) when: a major finding cites a .rs file; a finding cites both a docs path and a code path; a check failed; a behavior criterion is unmet; the verifier reported a request/reading mismatch; the candidate has admission violations; or no finding and no unmet criterion exists.
criteria.evidence: The table in docs_only_blocking_finding_retries_from_the_candidate_and_anything_else_from_the_base covers a .rs major finding, a mixed docs+code location, a docs major beside a Cargo.toml blocker, a failed check, an unmet behavior criterion, a mismatch and an admission violation. A separate case with no findings and no unmet criterion asserts false. All of these passed.

criteria.criterion: A test of the content-only classifier (in verify.rs) shows docs/…, *.md, and CHANGELOG.md locations classify as content-only, and src files, Cargo.toml, a missing location with no path, and mixed paths do not; minor findings do not block qualification.
criteria.evidence: finding_is_content_only_when_every_cited_path_is_non_code asserts true for docs/…, notes.md and CHANGELOG.md. It asserts false for src/lib.rs, Cargo.toml, athena.toml, mixed paths, an empty location, and a missing location whose prose names no path. only_blocker_and_major_findings_block covers severity. The reading.rs test shows a minor src finding beside a docs major still qualifies. Both tests passed.

criteria.criterion: A test through tree_retry_seed shows a docs-only-finding rejection yields a seed whose findings list includes the docs finding text; `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets` pass and `cargo fmt --check` is clean.
criteria.evidence: tree_retry_seed_docs_only_carries_the_docs_finding asserts the seed is Some, unmet is empty, and findings[0] contains 'major (docs/decisions.md:3005-3053): decision D122 is inserted inside D121'. It passed in my run. Athena's recorded checks: fmt passed, clippy passed, cargo test --locked passed (1274 tests).

criteria.criterion: The doc comment on qualifies_for_tree_retry states the new condition (no unmet criterion, all blocking findings cite only non-code files) and that the unknown-cause exclusion still applies otherwise.
criteria.evidence: Read in the diff: the comment adds 'or no criterion is unmet, at least one finding is a blocker or major, and every such blocking finding cites only non-code files…'. It also says 'Otherwise a rejection that names no unmet criterion and no blocking finding has an unknown cause, so it does not qualify'.

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry under the unreleased section describing that docs-only rejections now retry from the candidate, and that code-file findings or failed checks still retry from the base.
criteria.evidence: Read in the diff: a new bullet under [Unreleased] > Changed says such rejections now start from the rejected candidate. It also says a finding citing a code or configuration file, a failed check, etc. still retries from the base. It is written for outside readers.

findings.summary: location_tokens trims a leading '.' as well as quotes and brackets, so './docs/x.png' becomes '/docs/x.png'. That no longer matches the docs/ prefix and is classed as code.
findings.evidence: trim_matches includes '.', and it runs before path_of_token's trim_start_matches("./"). The error is on the safe side (a retry from the base), so it is harmless, but the './' stripping in path_of_token never takes effect.

summary: The change does what the request asks. `athena retry` now starts from the rejected candidate when every check passed, no criterion was unmet, and every blocker or major finding cites only non-code paths (Markdown, CHANGELOG, or anything under docs/). It still starts from the base for a finding that cites code, a failed check, an unmet behavior criterion, a request/reading mismatch, admission violations, or a rejection with no blocking finding. I ran the targeted tests (`cargo test -p athena-core docs_only` and `cargo test -p athena-core finding_`) and they pass. They would fail without the change. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and full test runs passed. The doc comment and the CHANGELOG entry are updated. D128 is appended after D127 in docs/decisions.md, not inserted inside another entry. Every changed file is on the expected deliverables list. One nit only: a leading './' is stripped badly, which errs toward retrying from the base.
